connect.hint: Type the address you open Innkeep at in a browser. Leave the password empty if yours asks for none, or to look at a demo.
error.address: That is not an address. Type it as you would in a browser.
error.unreachable: Can't reach that address. Check it and your connection, then try again.
error.not-innkeep: There is no Innkeep at that address.
error.password-needed: This Innkeep asks for a password.
error.password: That is not the password. Check it and try again.
error.too-many: Too many attempts. Try again in ten minutes.
error.outdated: This Innkeep is too old for the app. Update it, then try again.
error.server: Innkeep had a problem. Try again.
error.demo: This is a demo: changes are not saved.
error.signed-out: Your password changed. Sign in again.
error.offline: No connection. Showing what was loaded last.
error.title: Can’t Load
